description: Skill Defaults — SINKRA Behavioral Config. Resolution order (D5): .sinkra/config/ > .env > infrastructure-map.json. NO SECRETS — only behavioral configuration.

_notes.skill_threshold: Minimum validate-skill score to promote squad workflow → production skill
_notes.squad_threshold: Minimum validate-squad score for squad to be eligible for promotion
_notes.tier1_bypass_staging: Tier 1 skills can be created directly without staging

resolution_order.description: Order in which config values are resolved

chain.description: Deploy targets, service URLs, infra topology

_notes.ci_revalidation: CI re-validation when source squad changes

_notes.fail_deduction: Points deducted from quality score per FAIL finding in review-story
_notes.concerns_deduction: Points deducted per CONCERNS finding in review-story
_notes.fail: Risk score >= this triggers automatic FAIL gate verdict
_notes.concerns: Risk score >= this triggers CONCERNS gate verdict

_notes.base_path: Root directory for all learning logs (entries, logs, schemas)
_notes.pattern: Minimum confidence score for observation to be promoted to pattern
_notes.rule: Minimum confidence score for pattern to be promoted to rule

_notes.skip_behavior: Behavior when WSL/CodeRabbit unavailable: skip_with_warning | block | skip_silent
_notes.severity_filter: Minimum severity level to report: error | warning | info

_notes.coverage_target: Target percentage for registry update coverage score (close-story CHK-9)

_notes.fallback_agent: Agent ID to load when quality_gate agent file is not found in .claude/agents/. Used by /close-story Dynamic Agent Binding. Value = agent ID without @ prefix.
